name: Home(less)
source:
The life of an ordinary office worker changes when one cloudy day he decides to walk down an alley and stumbles upon a beastman who offered to make a deal.

[From [url=https://morlo.itch.io/homeless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個陰天，普普通通的上班族決定抄近路走進小巷，意外撞見一個要和他做交易的獸人。他的生活就此改變。

［摘自[url=https://morlo.itch.io/homeless]itch.io[/url]］
